status: Current active-roster campaign authoring. Candidate integration, move legality, earned balance and presentation remain to be verified.
policy: Only active Minnesota original Pokemon may appear in the authored Minnesota campaign. Retain unrelated Johto/Kanto source content. No species fallback and no legendary substitutes for ordinary teams or gifts.
migration_rules: Preserve ordinary trainer sizes, levels, held items and DVs. Explicit faction_teams are the authored exception: mixed regional coverage, native level/TM moves and Wrigglet-line boss aces.
If a mapped evolved form requires a higher level, use its legal earlier family member. Do not create underlevel evolutions.
Audit starter/gift/egg/wild/trade/picture/cry commands, visible dialogue names and creature actors as well as trainer parties.
Reject unmapped legacy species and active-roster targets missing from the actual pack.
Preserve all original audio, unrelated source regions and earned-result guards. Native balance and current Save/Continue must be verified again after migration.

faction_identity.balance: Distinct guards cover Fire/Rock and Steel/Water. Bosses mix Water, Steel, Ice/Poison and Bug support with the Wrigglet line. Preserve early Crookit identity; no underlevel Mosquitan, blanket evasion or legendary padding. Test native battles at expected player levels, not the overlevelled geometry fixture.
faction_identity.reed_continuity: Crookit stays with Reed from Winona and evolves into Crookveil. Vanechick and Wrigglet join at the relay and remain as Silohawk and Pupump through the mine and intake. The fourth slot reflects his industrial assignment. Levels and team sizes still require earned campaign verification.
faction_identity.early_counterplay: Early Cartick guards use Metal Claw, Mud-Slap and Poison Gas. Reserve their high-power Sludge Bomb and Shadow Ball coverage for later chapters. Do not require players to own rare species or machine-only counters.

campaign_team_adjustments.rationale: Use the reliable Water attack learned at level 24 rather than the opening Water Gun in the sixth Gym.
At its level-38 evolution, Orlis gains a distinct Grass/Water lead and a rain payoff instead of three redundant Grass attacks.
Restore both native Bug and Rock attacks lost by taking only the last four learned moves.
Restore native Bug STAB while retaining the Steel attack, coverage and setup.
Replace inaccurate two-turn Normal coverage with learned Flying STAB; retain the speed-pass role.
Keep the deliberate Lock-On combination while replacing redundant Rock coverage with reliable Steel STAB.
Use the family evolution available since level 38 at level 49, retaining the authored coverage.
Use the family evolution available at level 44 in the final Elite Four battle at level 50.
Keep the Fighting-stage identity beside Musketunge with both STAB attacks and a reliable Water option.
Offer a reliable Dragon attack before committing to Outrage, replacing the unsupported accuracy setup.
Replace the level-51 unevolved Chorip and its low-Attack Belly Drum set with the legal evolved specialist and both native STAB types.
Give the Champion ace reliable learned Dragon STAB and legal Ground coverage instead of unpaired 50-percent-accuracy Zap Cannon.

rules.consent: The leader states the party size and level range before YES/NO. Original Gym TM claims take priority.
rules.first_win_reward: One RARE_CANDY per leader. The victory receipt persists if the bag is full; collect without another battle.
rules.repeats: Optional unlimited battles award ordinary trainer prize money and experience; no repeated candy, badge or TM.
rules.balance_scope: Fixed authored teams and static legal-move checks. No claim of a complete campaign play balance pass.

refinement_team_adjustments.rationale: Keep Saven's Ground coverage and current level while replacing the midgame +6 Attack swing with the gentler, legal Focus Energy setup. The team still answers Rock and Electric approaches without requiring a single-turn Belly Drum response.

Show Reed's established Cartick partner evolving naturally at level 32 before the level-43 boundary encounter. Keep the encounter level, held item, DVs and rewards; remove repeat accuracy reduction and provide Haze counterplay against setup.

refinement_balance_review.scope: Static assessment of the exact adventure-v01 pack before refinement. This does not claim earned-play win rates, money exhaustion or perfect encounter difficulty.

preserved_curve.policy: No campaign level increases, XP multiplier changes, trainer reward cuts, wild-team scaling changes or forced postgame battles.

campaign_checkpoints.assessment: Keep levels 10-16 and four-move starter learning cadence. Rochester gains SUPER_POTION; Winona/Rochester gain REPEL to support exploration and return trips without level inflation.

Existing Ground answers are present before the electric/industrial sequence, including Route 2 habitat SODCALF and Route 3 MUDNIP. Minneapolis now sells reusable supplies of legal coverage/status TMs and affordable held boosters; the existing TM consumption rules remain.

Saven's level-29 BOOMRUFF retained MAGNITUDE but changes BELLY_DRUM to FOCUS_ENERGY to reduce extreme setup variance. Sivren's prior-release physical PIKEMAN repair and Water/Electric/Psychic diversity stay intact.

Retain the previous ZIZALITH evolution/move repair and level-40/45 aces. Grand Marais now stocks level-appropriate medicine, capture supplies, berries and four useful TMs; no shared Johto mart or global item price changes.

Preserve last-release twelve legal party corrections. Reed's CARTICK evolves to HAULGEIST at the same level, with a clear Poison/Ghost role and no accuracy spam. Reminder and renewable TM stock let players repair their own moves before the League.

Keep optional leader rematch levels and consent. First unclaimed gifts become eight themed held items, existing candy receipts stay claimed, guides show missing wins, and all eight earned wins unlock one retryable LEFTOVERS. Reed is a separate optional 57-59 six-partner challenge with recognizable weaknesses and one held healing berry.

refinement_balance_review.limits: These are table, legality and availability conclusions. Static evidence does not establish how much grinding a player needs or how often each starter wins.
